page: Microsoft Azure E2nds_v6 is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine belonging to the Endv6 server family. It runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor and features 2 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel processor. The instance is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

This server type includes 118 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and is capable of utilizing Premium Storage. Classified as network-optimized, the E2nds_v6 is designed to handle workloads requiring enhanced network throughput alongside fast local read and write operations. No GPU accelerators are present on this instance.

With its 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the E2nds_v6 represents a resource-dense entry point for memory-optimized workloads. The inclusion of dedicated vCPUs and local NVMe storage makes it qualitatively cost-efficient for small-scale databases, caching layers, and memory-intensive web serving applications that do not require massive parallel CPU compute but benefit from high memory allocation and fast local disk access.
